previewHelp: Review the fingerprint and optional keystore policy changes before applying.
configHelp: Edit Build fields, system properties, wildcards and advanced PIF options. Nothing changes until you apply the preview.
generateHelp: Fetch current Pixel Canary metadata over HTTPS. Generation only prepares a candidate and may take up to two minutes. A fingerprint does not guarantee any verdict.
saved: Configuration saved. Restart PI processes to apply process-local changes.
fileLimit: Choose a file of at most 64 KiB.
compatibilityHelp: Compatibility changes require reboot. Existing PIF or USNF modules remain untouched and prevent duplicate activation.
reboot: Reboot required for lifecycle or mode changes.
restartSent: Process restart request sent; inspect each result below.
limits: Configuration and logs cannot prove an integrity verdict. Zygisk, ROM compatibility and server acceptance require device verification.
attribution: Based on Play Integrity Fork (GPLv3), modified.
licenseScope: Engine: GPLv3. Independent management interface: MIT. Original and dependency notices are preserved.
syncPatch: Also apply this keystore patch policy
fieldsHelp: Empty fields are skipped. Unset options retain platform or legacy defaults. Every edit requires a preview before application.
wildcardHelp: Property wildcards support a leading * suffix match only. Exact property names take priority.
enableHelp: Lifecycle and global property changes require reboot. Saving configuration and restarting PI are separate actions.
denylistHelp: Magisk DenyList is managed automatically: full mode removes GMS and Play Store; scripts-only mode adds them. This changes your root manager’s list.
selinuxHelp: In permissive mode, upstream compatibility behavior restricts reads of SELinux enforce/policy files. It does not change the kernel to enforcing.

flagHelp.spoofBuild: Override Build fields in the target process.
flagHelp.spoofProps: Override system property reads in the target process.
flagHelp.spoofProvider: Legacy compatibility: block DroidGuard certificate-chain requests. This can conflict with hardware attestation.
flagHelp.spoofSignature: Override package signatures locally; this does not change server-side app recognition.
flagHelp.spoofVendingFinger: 0: off; 1: use FINGERPRINT; otherwise use this custom fingerprint.
flagHelp.spoofVendingSdk: 0: off; 1: legacy ceiling 32; other positive values cap the local Play Store SDK. Takes priority over its fingerprint option.
flagHelp.verboseLogs: Logging level 0–100; 100 includes all observed property reads.

warnings.patch_scope: Configured partition patch dates differ. A single-date keystore update is skipped; your configuration is retained.
warnings.missing_api: First API level is unset; no universal SDK value is assumed.
warnings.mismatch: Build and the matching system property have different explicit values.
warnings.provider: Provider compatibility blocks certificate-chain requests; verify whether your setup needs it.
warnings.wildcard: Unsupported wildcard: only a leading * suffix match is implemented.
warnings.canary: Canary retains upstream heuristics: Pixel 10a uses API 35 despite the noted actual 36; unknown devices use 37; board API uses 32. Six-week expiry and patch fallback are estimates, not Google acceptance or certificate validity.
warnings.vending_priority: Play Store SDK compatibility is enabled and overrides its fingerprint replacement.
warnings.pixel_patch_unknown: Google build metadata does not provide an exact security patch date. The candidate leaves it unset.

strongHelp: Sets spoofProvider=0 for this candidate. Build and property patch values stay paired; no verdict is guaranteed.
recoveryHelp: An update did not finish. Review the journal path, then confirm restoration of the saved configurations. Further applications are blocked until recovery finishes.
replaceHelp: Only individual entries under app, priv-app or overlay in system, product, system_ext, vendor, odm or oem are allowed. Wildcards are limited to app names; roots, parent paths and overlay/config are rejected.
activationHelp: Full mode changes the global environment only after a nonempty configuration is applied. Explicitly saving scripts-only mode enables compatibility scripts without a fingerprint.
powerHelp: Stop future injection and compatibility scripts independently of configuration validation. Existing hooks need a PI process restart; mounted overlays and global properties need a device reboot.
disabledHelp: PIF is disabled. Configuration and other toolbox features are retained. Restart PI processes and reboot to clear existing effects.
cleanupPending: The stop gate is active, but some cleanup remains. External edits are preserved. Review the details and retry after resolving them.
denylistRestoreHelp: On disable, restore only recorded DenyList changes that have not been edited externally. Magisk may terminate affected processes. Unrecorded older changes are not guessed.
persistRestoreHelp: Persistent compatibility properties follow upstream restoration: recorded original values are written back and can overwrite later changes to those properties.

editing.syncHelp: Copies nonempty Build values to their matching properties in this draft. Review changes before applying.

profiles.title: Saved configurations
profiles.help: Save up to 12 named snapshots. Previewing a snapshot does not apply it or enable PIF.
profiles.name: Configuration name
profiles.saved: Snapshot saved. The active configuration is unchanged.
profiles.removeHelp: Only this saved snapshot will be removed. The applied configuration is retained.
profiles.invalid: This snapshot could not be read. Other snapshots are available.

inspection.title: Information comparison
inspection.help: Compare current system property readings with the saved Build and property overrides. Other modules may already affect system readings.
inspection.unavailable: System properties could not be read. Saved values remain available.
inspection.unobserved: Target process values have not been observed. These readings do not prove injection or a Google verdict.
inspection.observed: Readbacks match the saved configuration revision and a live process in this boot. They are local diagnostics, not a Google verdict.
inspection.runtimeError: Process readbacks could not be loaded. Restart or open the target apps and refresh.

history.title: Test history
history.help: Manual observations, linked to the saved configuration and engine mode at recording time. These are not verified verdicts. Keeps the latest 24 records.
history.clearHelp: All manual test records will be removed. Configurations are retained.
history.importHelp: Paste decoded Play Integrity JSON. Only verdict labels and app/license details are retained. Missing labels are not treated as failed checks.
history.unverified: Imported report supplied by the user; authenticity has not been verified.

guide.title: Rules and references
guide.pif: An additional fingerprint override may improve or worsen results. Keep an already working setup unless there is a reason to change it.
guide.official: On Android 13+, Device requires hardware-backed locked boot and a certified OS image. Strong also requires updates within the last year across all partitions. Optional labels depend on the requesting app’s Play license. First shipped API is different from the running OS version; local checks cannot prove server acceptance.
guide.community: October 2026 reports describe changed results, including improvement after disabling PIF and success with some specific configurations. PixelOS also reported a server-side change. The exact checks are unpublished; neither a universal Pixel ban nor an API 32–35 pass rule is established.
guide.canary: This downloads a Pixel Canary candidate. Newer does not necessarily suit your device better. Generation prepares a preview and does not apply it.
guide.import: Use an imported or custom configuration instead

pixel.title: Pixel fingerprints
pixel.help: Fetch Google release metadata, select a device and build, then preview. Pixel 6a is selected initially. This does not establish Google acceptance.
pixel.patchUnknown: Exact security patch date is unavailable. No patch date is inferred or synchronized.

quick.title: Fingerprint controls
quick.vendingHelp: Play Store fingerprint mode changes FINGERPRINT only. SDK compatibility takes precedence over fingerprint replacement.
quick.draft: Changes affect this draft. Preview and apply to save them.

activation.reboot: Configuration saved. Reboot the device to finish activation; restarting PI processes does not clear this requirement.
activation.process: Configuration saved. Restart PI processes to load the new values.

patch.help: These changes affect attestation policy, not installed security updates. Unselected partitions retain their configuration.
patch.draft: Partition edits are not previewed. Update the preview before selecting synchronization.
patch.multipleTargets: Only one keystore backend can be synchronized at a time.
patch.targetUnavailable: The keystore backend is no longer active. Refresh the configuration preview.

archive.title: Pixel property library
archive.help: Select a device and channel from the community archive to preview a PI configuration. Patch dates come from the selected build. Boot hash is shown for reference only; acceptance requires device testing.
